statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk sits at the floor of the low band because CME index futures are halted for the weekend and no live Nasdaq-100 price path exists.
recommendation: Tail remains far below the block threshold, so the deterministic mapping stays EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. A narrow evidence-based caution window is flagged around the 22:00 UTC Sunday futures reopen and the early Asian session, where the weekend's rate-hike repricing gets its first price test. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain unaffected by this mapping.
headline: Nasdaq-100: hawkish post-Jackson-Hole rate repricing meets a weekend futures halt; tail risk stays low into the Sunday reopen
body: Assessment is made during the weekend CME halt, so there is no live NQ price path and no mean-reversion failure can be developing. The anchor is Friday's verified close: NDX 29,433.43, down 0.70%, settling in the lower part of a 29,383.92-29,752.78 range, with VIX at 14.43. The dominant new information is policy-related rather than structural. Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks lifted September rate-hike odds from roughly 35% to near 60%, the 2-year yield rose about 11 basis points to 4.34%, the 10-year reached 4.72% and the 30-year 5.21% in a bear-flattening move. PCE stands at 3.7% year over year with core at 3.3%. Cross-asset alignment is only partial: yields higher and gold lower against a calm VIX and flat crude, with WTI at 83.44 dollars and Brent at 88.29 dollars, and the Iran situation currently characterised as an economic and sanctions confrontation rather than an imminent supply threat. Friday's index weakness also had an identifiable single-name component in Marvell's roughly 7-8% decline on Google custom-chip revenue timing. Under the standing framework, event importance, forecast dispersion and repricing magnitude inform Stress and Confidence; Tail escalation requires observed persistent directional efficiency, shallow or failed retracements, or several independent current amplifiers, none of which can exist during a halt. Tail is therefore held at the low-band floor for the halted hours and lifted only modestly, still within the low band, across the Sunday reopen and the Asian session, where the first genuine price test of the repricing occurs. The substantive catalysts sit beyond this window: ISM Manufacturing and JOLTS on Tuesday, ADP and the Beige Book on Wednesday, claims and ISM Services on Thursday, and the August employment report on Friday, ahead of the 15-16 September FOMC.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding hourly slots carry a published Claude assessment. The series was uniformly green with Tail held at 5 and dominant mode normal throughout, spanning Friday's US cash session, the Friday close and the weekend halt. Stress sat at 24-26 and Confidence decayed steadily from 80 to 58 as the published evidence aged across the closed weekend without refresh.
outlookSummary: The next 17 hours fall inside the weekend CME halt, where no price path can form and Tail stays at the low-band floor. From the 22:00 UTC Sunday reopen Tail is projected to rise modestly to 12-13, still inside the low band, covering the first price test of the near-60% September rate-hike pricing, thin reopen liquidity and gap risk in either direction. It then eases to 10 through the Asian afternoon on expected volatility decay. Every post-reopen structure is stated conditionally because none of it is observable now. Monday brings month-end flows and a London bank holiday that thins European liquidity, while the first top-tier US catalyst is Tuesday's ISM Manufacturing.
